reason: I'd play with the free tricks for a family evening, but I just don't pay for apps, and there are free magic apps that do something similar. 99 shekels for a party trick I'll use a few times isn't how I spend money on my phone.
objection: There are free magic apps that do the same, and I'm not typing my card into some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks genuinely blew my kids or students away and nothing free came close, maybe I'd pay a small one-off amount like 20-30 shekels.
